answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Each submission hangs on the cipher of a task receipt, and the zenith is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a formal academic rhythm, balance of technical clauses and empirical references register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the voyage of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
